name: Zurich Marató de Barcelona
summary: The Zurich Marató de Barcelona runs through the streets of Barcelona in March. The 2025 course goes from Passeig de Gràcia to the Arc de Triomf and has about 134 m of climbing. Long straight roads and a few gentle rises make it a fast course.
courseHighlights: Sagrada Família around km 14, the highest point of the course
Coastal stretch past the Hotel Arts and the Fòrum, km 27–31
Finish at the Arc de Triomf

paceStrategy.summary: Run the first half evenly, because the climbing is spread across both halves (76 m in the first, 58 m in the second). Keep some energy for the last 10 km, which pass through Poblenou and the Vila Olímpica before the finish.

segments.terrain: Eixample streets, including a 4.72 km straight on Carrer de València
segments.advice: Stay relaxed and do not chase the crowd in the first kilometres.

segments.terrain: Avinguda Meridiana, the Sagrada Família (highest point at km 14), then Rambla de Catalunya
segments.advice: Run by effort on the gentle rise, then settle back to goal pace.

segments.terrain: Avinguda Paral·lel, Ciutadella park, then the flat coastal road
segments.advice: Hold steady pace on the flat road along the sea.

segments.terrain: Avinguda Diagonal, Poblenou, Carrer Marina and the finish at the Arc de Triomf
segments.advice: Keep your form and push only in the last 3 km.

fuelingNotes: Refreshment points start at km 5 and come every 2.5 km, with water, isotonic drink and fruit. Take a gel before each one so you can wash it down, and plan your last gel before km 37.5 on Carrer Pallars.
tips: The course has 43 curves, so run the corners tight and keep an eye on the racing line
Use the refreshment points every 2.5 km from km 5 to plan when to drink
The start is on Passeig de Gràcia in the city centre, so allow time to reach your start corral
The long straight on Carrer de València (km 5–10) can feel dull, so pace by watch and effort

faq.question: Is the Barcelona Marathon course flat?
faq.answer: It is mostly flat. The 2025 course has about 134 m of total climbing, 76 m in the first half and 58 m in the second. The highest point is at the Sagrada Família around km 14.

faq.question: When is the Barcelona Marathon held?
Where does the Barcelona Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: The 2025 course started on Passeig de Gràcia and finished at the Arc de Triomf. Check the official site for any change to the route.
